rheumatology.unit_name: Reumatología / Unidad de Reumatología, Departamento de Medicina Interna, Clínica Las Condes
rheumatology.evidence_quote: “Somos un equipo especialista en Reumatología”. La lista vigente de subespecialidades incluye Mastología, Cirugía de Tórax, Cirugía Plástica, Cirugía Vascular, Coloproctología y Medicina Intensiva; no incluye Reumatología.

hiring.positions_note: The official jobs portal showed 8 current vacancies today. One is an academic-leadership role, “Director Escuela de Historia”; no Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Rheumatology academic post was open today.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No currently open Medicine/Internal Medicine academic post was published, so there is no published job requirement concerning foreign medical degrees, revalidación, or Chilean nationality to quote. Separately, UFT’s medical-specialty admissions page requires: “Poseer el título de Médico Cirujano legalmente inscrito en Chile.”

international.notes: The 2026 incoming fact sheet lists five English-taught exchange courses—Change Management, Intercultural Negotiation, Business Strategy, Design Thinking, and Intercultural Challenges in Latin America—none in Medicine. It states that the entire curriculum is offered in Spanish subject to approval. The faculty also has a UChicago Medicine cooperation agreement.

profile_paragraphs: UFT’s current Faculty of Medicine and Health was created as the Faculty of Medicine in 2001; it incorporated Dentistry in December 2025. Its dean is Dr Ernesto Vega Asún.
Medicine received CNA accreditation for seven years in August 2026, valid to August 2033. This is the maximum period reported by the university.

Its Medicine specialty programme includes Internal Medicine, a three-year programme with clinical fields at Clínica Las Condes, Clínica Santa María, Hospital de La Florida, HUAP, Hospital El Carmen, HOSMET and the Instituto Nacional del Tórax.

For a rheumatologist, the clearest local clinical link is the UFT–Clínica Las Condes campus. Clínica Las Condes has a Rheumatology unit, but UFT’s current published specialty and subspecialty catalogues do not list a Rheumatology training programme.

The public vacancy portal had no Medicine, Internal Medicine or Rheumatology academic opening on 3 September 2026. A prospective clinical applicant should note the specialty-admission rule requiring a medical title legally registered in Chile.
